## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 3D cricket franchise management game inspired by the Indian Premier League.

## Requirements
- Let the player choose a franchise, manage its squad, and spend a fixed auction budget on players with different stats.
- Include AI rival franchises that bid and play; keep the auction short, around 100 players and 4 teams.
- Support phone and tablet play.

- Use four original fictional franchises and players.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, mobile/tablet-friendly 3D cricket franchise management game inspired by the Indian Premier League.

## Requirements
- Let the player choose a franchise, manage its squad, and spend a fixed auction budget on players with different stats.
- Include AI rival franchises that bid and play; keep the auction short, around 100 players and 4 teams.
- Support phone and tablet play.

## Decisions
- Use four original fictional franchises and players, a ₹100 Cr purse, 12 marquee auction lots, four-player match squads, and a three-fixture season with 2-over innings.
- Render a Three.js stadium scene with a canvas fallback.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the responsive game flow: franchise selection, auction, squad, fixtures, ball-by-ball matches, standings, and season results.
- Added rival AI bidding, player stats, budgets, batting/bowling tactics, quick-over control, and match scoring.
- Fixed auction AI progression so rival bids continue and lots close; browser-tested auction completion and squad creation.
- Added a post-match continue/results button; browser-tested the first fixture through its completed match state.
- `node --check game.js` passed after auction and match UI changes; browser reported zero console errors during match testing.

### Active
- Validate progression through the remaining fixtures and final season results.
- Check phone/tablet layout and review the browser’s four console warnings.

- (none)

- `game.js`: game data, auction, franchise/season logic, match simulation, and 3D scene.
- `index.html`: responsive UI shell and styling.
- `screenshots/selection.jpg`: selection screen capture.
- `screenshots/auction.jpg`: auction screen capture.
